_comment: Template for tools/ca_orders.py. Copy to ca_execution.json (gitignored, like user_config.json) and replace the FICTIONAL figures below with your own. cash: what the account holds in each currency. positions: Canadian execution tickers only (common/ca_mapping.py), whole units; the currency is read from the table. execution.leverage above 1.0 is refused (EXEC-001). prefer_usd_units spends USD already in the account on a fund's .U class and never converts CAD to reach one. usdcad: null to look the rate up, or a number to fix it. prices: optional per-ticker overrides that win over the downloaded close.
